milestones.goal: J1 works end to end on Monad testnet: a phone claims, the board shows its place with the block number, on the deployed URL; backup take recorded
J2 and J3 plus the demo-critical screens: keeper, bot round, board and buyer states to the mockup, seller page, motion, release gates
Freeze: venue rehearsal, final take, submission

tasks.title: Scaffold the app and contracts; validate the RPC and the operator wallet
tasks.objective: Next.js app and Foundry project exist with typecheck/test scripts; one real call to Monad testnet returns chain id 10143 and the operator balance
acceptance: WHEN scripts/check-rpc.mjs runs THE SYSTEM SHALL print chain id 10143, the latest block and the operator's MON balance (> 10 MON)
WHEN npm run build runs THE SYSTEM SHALL build with no type errors
tasks.rollback: delete the scaffold commit; nothing deployed

tasks.title: DropHouse, TestRupee and Funder contracts with tests
tasks.objective: The contract interface in ARCHITECTURE.md is implemented and every rule in AC-1..AC-5 is covered by a forge test, rules RED first
tasks.rollback: git revert the T02 commit; nothing deployed yet

tasks.title: Deploy the contracts to Monad testnet and create drop 1
tasks.objective: TestRupee, Funder and DropHouse deployed and verified on MonadVision; drop 1 created with three pieces; addresses written to deployments/testnet.json and seed/drop.json holds the piece metadata
acceptance: WHEN scripts/check-deploy.mjs runs THE SYSTEM SHALL read drop 1 from the deployed DropHouse and print 3 pieces, price 450, deposit 50
verify: observe: the three contracts open as verified on testnet.monadvision.com
tasks.rollback: redeploy; addresses are config, no state to migrate

tasks.title: Server core: indexer, SSE stream, wallet funding, send relay, health
tasks.objective: One process indexes DropHouse events (WebSocket + backfill), streams a snapshot and deltas over SSE, funds a burner once, relays signed transactions across RPCs, and reports health
acceptance: WHEN /api/send receives a tx to any other address THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it with 400
WHEN the server restarts THE SYSTEM SHALL rebuild the same drop state from logs
tasks.rollback: git revert; the chain holds the state

tasks.title: Golden path UI: bare buyer page and board on live data (UI prompt U1 + U2)
tasks.objective: Tokens and fonts in place; /d/1 creates and funds a burner and sends a real claim; /board/1 lists claims from the stream with block numbers
acceptance: WHEN a claim is built THE SYSTEM SHALL set explicit gas and maxPriorityFeePerGas <= 2 gwei
verify: observe: a phone taps Dibs and the board shows its row with a block number within 2 s, 5 times

tasks.title: First deploy to Railway and smoke it
tasks.objective: The app runs on a stable public URL with env set; the golden path works from a phone on mobile data
acceptance: WHEN the deployed URL is opened signed out THE SYSTEM SHALL serve /, /d/1, /board/1 and /api/health with 200
verify: observe: a phone on mobile data claims on the deployed URL and the deployed board shows it

tasks.title: Backup take: record the working path
tasks.objective: A 60-90 s screen recording of the deployed board while two phones claim and one holder lets the window lapse (if T08 is not in yet, claims only)
acceptance: WHEN the venue network fails during the pitch THE TEAM SHALL have a recording of the real run to play
verify: observe: backup recording saved outside the repo and plays at 1x with legible block numbers

tasks.title: Keeper, admin routes and the bot round
tasks.objective: The keeper rolls lapsed holders; presenter routes start the drop and run a 100-wallet bot round that claims and abandons, plus one over-cap tip that is refused and counted
acceptance: IF an admin route is called without the presenter key THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL return 401
verify: observe: bot round on testnet: 100 claims land, every abandoned claim forfeits to the seller, one over-cap tip is refused
tasks.rollback: git revert; disable the bot button

tasks.title: Board to the mockup (UI prompt U3)
tasks.objective: The projector board matches ui/mockup/Main.dc.html and BoardRolled.dc.html with every board state
verify: observe: /board/1?state=waiting|live|rolled|sold|disconnected each match the mockup at 1440x900

tasks.title: Buyer page states, pay and withdraw (UI prompt U4)
tasks.objective: Every buyer state in UI-SPEC works on live data, including pay with permit and withdraw, and the claim ticket page
acceptance: IF a claim fails THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL show the reason and take no deposit
verify: observe: pay and withdraw on testnet from a phone

tasks.title: Seller page, landing, responsive pass (UI prompt U5)
tasks.objective: Seller page and landing as in UI-SPEC; no horizontal scroll at 320; first screens pass foldcheck
verify: observe: foldcheck passes for /d/1 (phone) and /board/1 (desktop) on the deployed URL

tasks.title: Motion and the holder chime (UI prompt U6)
tasks.objective: T-01..T-07 from UI-SPEC: stubs snap in, the holder stub tears off, the deposit chip travels, the chime plays behind the sound toggle; reduced motion respected
acceptance: WHEN a holder is forfeited THE SYSTEM SHALL animate the tear-off and chip within 600 ms and keep LED digits unanimated
verify: observe: screen recording of a claim burst and one no-show at 1x

tasks.title: Release gates: security, observability, cleanup, design review (UI prompt U7)
tasks.objective: Secrets and client bundle checked, abuse limits on /api/send and /api/wallet verified, health shows lag and balance, dead code removed, prod-ui A8 gates 1-4 recorded, README first screen and OG image done
acceptance: WHEN the client bundle is searched THE SYSTEM SHALL contain no private key or RPC secret
IF /api/send gets more than 5 txs per address in 10 s THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL return 429
verify: observe: grep of .next/static for PK, 0x-prefixed 64-hex strings and RPC keys finds none
observe: prod-ui A8 gates 1-4 recorded in the UI-SPEC acceptance section

tasks.title: Venue rehearsal: burst on the venue network and three demo runs
tasks.objective: A 50-transaction burst from real phones on the venue network, then the exact demo script three times in a row with a fresh drop each time
acceptance: WHEN the demo script runs three times THE SYSTEM SHALL complete each run without a manual fix
verify: observe: 50-tx burst from phones on venue Wi-Fi: all claims land, median tap to place under 2 s
observe: three consecutive demo runs completed with a new drop each

tasks.title: Final take from the frozen build
tasks.objective: A clean 90-120 s recording of the full demo on the deployed URL, kept as the pitch fallback
acceptance: WHEN the pitch network fails THE TEAM SHALL play the final take
verify: observe: final take saved outside the repo; plays at 1x; block numbers legible at 720p

tasks.title: Submit: fork name and one-liner, README first screen, Blitz Portal
tasks.objective: The fork carries the project name and one-liner; README's first screen has the sentence, a screenshot, the live link and the live-vs-simulated table; the Blitz Portal entry is submitted; pb.py window and submit check pass
acceptance: WHEN a voter opens the fork THE SYSTEM SHALL show the one-liner, a screenshot and a working live link with no placeholders
verify: python3 .prod-build/pb.py submit check --description "Dibs: a claim link for Instagram thrift drops. Buyers tap at once, Monad records the order, and a no-show's deposit pays the seller as the item rolls to #2." --live https://REPLACE-WITH-RAILWAY-URL --online
tasks.rollback: edit the README; resubmit before the deadline
